purpose: Do not bypass the user-facing question flow or treat ambiguous uploaded images as references. This policy supersedes older intake_playbook, clarification_rules and guided_flow conflicts.

precedence.0: User explicitly supplied content and previously confirmed answers are retained; do not re-ask.
precedence.1: Ambiguous uploaded images to be used in the output are a hard stop. Confirm image roles before reference selection or image generation, even if user asks for instant generation.
precedence.2: Required truthful content and user portrait consent/ownership uncertainties should never be fabricated. Ask if necessary; allow a neutral visual fallback when user agrees.
precedence.3: Explicit guided8 mode requires step-by-step progression; max two questions in older clarification rules does NOT apply.
precedence.4: In assisted/default mode, ask only one high-impact question if content is materially ambiguous; give 3 useful choices plus auto-generate.
precedence.5: Instant and local-edit modes skip cosmetic questions only, not unresolved asset roles or factual constraints.
precedence.6: Only after the generation gate is ready may a multimodal model/image-edit call be made.
